text:
Nisha: Heads-up — e2e-decode-pipeline CI flagged a regression on main, p95 decode jumped from ~110ms to ~360ms after recent runtime merge. Anyone on kernel selector around?
perf-bot: CI job https://ci.redwood/inference/8032 flagged at commit def4567 (merge "kernel-selector: reweight memory penalty for prefix")
Shawn: that change adjusted the memory penalty calc… we probably mis-handled prefix clustering
Liam: I can repro with a small harness. When the selector picks fallback_kernel p95 climbs. I attached perf record + flamegraph.
Maria: flamegraph: https://files.redwood/snapshots/1968273001/fg.svg
Maria: quick trace snippet:
```
decode_token()
  -> kv_cache_lookup
  -> attn_opt_fallback
    -> prep_buffers (copy)
    -> slower_gemm
```
Jon: paste kernel selector debug log from the failed run?
Maria: log:
```
[DEBUG] selector: model=redwood/galen-13b, seq=1280, prefix=640, chosen=fallback_kernel_v3, score=-0.45, mem_est=1.8GB, cap=2.0GB
```
Nisha: prefix=640 should have favored the optimized kernel for our model/profile. Looks like mem_est overshot. suspect bug in the new prefix bucketing logic in def4567
Liam: ran a bisect across last 12 merges, repro lands squarely on def4567. Reverting that commit locally restores p95 to baseline.
Shawn: can we gate a hot-revert on main? This is blocking canary.
deploy-bot: Canary rollouts paused for inference-runtime due to regression detection
Jon: +1 to revert. Also we need a unit perf test for the selector behavior with mixed prefix distributions
Maria: I'm opening revert + test PR now: https://git.redwood/reverts/412 — test will replay a representative token stream and assert chosen_kernel==optimized_kernel
Liam: I'll run verification across GPUs (A100, H100) and with KV warmup patterns. Noted that repeated prefix >512 increases the mem_est via an accumulate factor; that seems wrong.
Shawn: we'll also add a cap and a smoothing factor to mem_est calculation as follow-up
Nisha: action items:
- Maria: land revert + test PR
- Liam: cross-GPU verification + KV warmup tests
- Shawn: follow-up patch to adjust mem_est heuristic
- Jon: keep canary paused and update release notes
perf-bot: revert PR queued (#412); CI rerun scheduled
Maria: revert merged, CI green on A100; H100 run still in progress
Nisha: thanks — keep canary paused until we have the follow-up patch and the test in main. :+1:
